overview.oneLineTake: AI-led selling and Nvidia credit stress keep risk tilted lower, and holiday-thin liquidity raises the odds of sharp moves.
themes: AI infrastructure unwind: headlines point to Nasdaq futures down about 3% with Nvidia and AMD slumping, and AI stocks sliding on fears over buildout costs.
Nvidia credit stress: S&P is reported to be threatening a downgrade as the CDS widens to a record, and the failed Nvidia rally keeps tech leadership in question.
Inflation and the Fed: PCE inflation coverage keeps rate relief in doubt, and the 10-year yield sat at 4.92% (Nov 23 print).
Broad tape: SPY closed at 716.70 on Nov 25, down 0.29%, so the damage is concentrated in AI leaders so far.
Oil: reports of elevated Russian crude shipments add to supply surplus talk.
risks: Further AI de-rating or a credit downgrade forcing index-level selling.
Thanksgiving today: US markets are closed, so liquidity is thin and gaps can follow into Friday's half session.
Sticky inflation keeping yields near 4.9% and pressuring multiples.

nq.summary: NDX cash closed -0.64% at 26,047 Wednesday after tagging 24,971, a full reversal off bear market territory as dip buyers stepped in. With US cash shut today, NQ trades a thin holiday session, so expect chop and headline driven spikes rather than trend. Thesis: neutral, 3/10, fade extremes in thin trade. Invalidation: clean break of 26,214 or 26,000. NDX levels: resistance 26,082 (Wed H), 26,214 (Tue close), 26,434 (Tue H); support 26,000 (round), 25,310 (Wed open), 24,971 (Wed L).
nq.primaryCatalyst: US Thanksgiving, cash closed; BOE Financial Stability Report at 5:30 PM BKK.
nq.overnight: NQ futures near 26,133 (session high 26,167.5, low 25,997.5), above its 26,068.5 open; Asia firmer after the US recovery, Nikkei up about 1%; UKMTO reports a projectile blast near a tanker 50NM west of Dubai, no damage.
nq.macro: 10Y eased to 4.85% (-1.14%) and DXY -0.11%; lower yields helped long duration tech recover into the close. No US data today.
nq.volatility: VIX 28.29 (+7.32%), intraday high 34.95 before fading. VXN and dealer gamma unavailable.
